parameters.content:
## Ops: Retention (must be ACTIVE)
Nightly 02:00 SAST purge per section 7 of the Automation Standard: processed_items 90d, runs + ai_calls 180d, workflow_errors 90d, decided review_queue 180d, eval_runs 365d. One statement (data-modifying CTEs) so every table is purged or none is, and it returns the counts. Projects with personal data add their own steps and shorten these periods.

parameters.query:
WITH p AS (DELETE FROM processed_items WHERE processed_at < now() - interval '90 days' RETURNING 1),
     r AS (DELETE FROM runs WHERE created_at < now() - interval '180 days' RETURNING 1),
     a AS (DELETE FROM ai_calls WHERE created_at < now() - interval '180 days' RETURNING 1),
     e AS (DELETE FROM workflow_errors WHERE created_at < now() - interval '90 days' RETURNING 1),
     q AS (DELETE FROM review_queue WHERE status <> 'pending' AND decided_at < now() - interval '180 days' RETURNING 1),
     v AS (DELETE FROM eval_runs WHERE created_at < now() - interval '365 days' RETURNING 1)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM p)::int AS processed_items_purged,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM r)::int AS runs_purged,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM a)::int AS ai_calls_purged,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM e)::int AS workflow_errors_purged,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM q)::int AS review_queue_purged,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM v)::int AS eval_runs_purged;
